name: in-place-runs-deliver
description: Make runs edit the project checkout directly: implement, validate with unit and e2e tests, two independent reviews, loop until approved.

steps.prompt:
Read /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory/.agents/tasks/in-place-runs/brief.md fully and obey its hard constraints (no commits/pushes/branch changes in code-factory, no git checkout/reset/stash/clean/restore on it, format only changed files, leave .kiro/workflows alone, do not touch tags-labels-ui, its worktree folder or ~/.kiro).

Artifacts dir: /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory/.agents/pipeline/2026-10-08-in-place-runs/ (create it if missing).

If verdict.json exists in that directory, this is a repair round: read it plus code-review-a.md, code-review-b.md and validation.json there, and fix every HIGH/MEDIUM finding and every validation failure (LOW/NIT when cheap, otherwise justify). Otherwise this is round 1: record the starting HEAD (`git -C /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory log -1 --format=%h`) and an ordered plan in 04-plan.md, then implement every user decision and fix in the brief.

Add the tests listed in the brief (real git temp repos, UI tests, Playwright e2e proving the project directory itself changes). Update README and docs/architecture.md. Run all checks from the brief and fix failures you caused. Write 05-code-summary.md (overwrite) with starting HEAD, files changed, decision-by-decision mapping, tests added, round number and exact check results. Do not delete verdict.json yourself.

VALIDATION ONLY in /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory. Do not edit source, tests or docs; do not commit or change git state. Obey /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory/.agents/tasks/in-place-runs/brief.md.

Run, each with exit code and a bounded summary: `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `./node_modules/.bin/vitest run`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test:e2e`. If e2e cannot start for environmental reasons, record it as `blocked` with the error; install nothing. Confirm `git -C /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory log -1 --format=%h` equals the starting HEAD recorded in 05-code-summary.md (no commits made) and list `git status --short`.

Write /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory/.agents/pipeline/2026-10-08-in-place-runs/validation.json (overwrite) as {"round": <n from 05-code-summary.md>, "passed": <true only if every command exited 0 and HEAD unchanged>, "commands": [{"name":..., "exit":..., "summary":...}], "head": "...", "changedFiles": [...]}.

branches.prompt:

Spec: /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory/.agents/tasks/in-place-runs/brief.md; also read 04-plan.md, 05-code-summary.md and validation.json in that directory.

steps.prompt:
Merge this round's evidence into one verdict. Read code-review-a.md, code-review-b.md, validation.json and 05-code-summary.md in /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory/.agents/pipeline/2026-10-08-in-place-runs/. Deduplicate and keep severities.

Write verdict.json in that directory (overwrite) as {"approved": <bool>, "round": <n>, "validationPassed": <bool>, "blocking": [{"severity":..., "source":..., "file":..., "summary":..., "fix":...}], "nonBlocking": [...]} and a human-readable 06-verdict.md.
